name: P09 — the field camera: follow, orbit, ease-behind, lead, modes, cutscene, clean occluder fade

steps.note: the opening frame: high-ish third person, the lane leading away, the hero reading clearly

steps.msg: the fade pass found the map's occluders

steps.note: SPRING FOLLOW + LEAD: walk up the lane; the camera eases behind him and leads the walk

EASE-BEHIND without fighting: hold right for two and a half seconds and MEASURE it — the camera swings round behind him while his path stays straight (the swing goes into the camera, never into the walk frame)

steps.eval: (async () => { const {Field} = await import('/src/world/field.js'); const orbit0 = __DQ.cameraOrbit(); const pts = []; let maxDrift = 0; __DQ.hold('right', 2600); for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); const c = __DQ.state().field.camera; const p = Field.world().player.p; maxDrift = Math.max(maxDrift, Math.abs(c.drift)); pts.push([+p.x.toFixed(2), +p.z.toFixed(2)]); } const a = pts[1], b = pts[pts.length - 1]; const dx = b[0] - a[0], dz = b[1] - a[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; let bend = 0; for (const q of pts.slice(1)) bend = Math.max(bend, Math.abs((q[0] - a[0]) * dz - (q[1] - a[1]) * dx) / L); window.__p09 = {orbit0, orbit1: __DQ.cameraOrbit(), walk: __DQ.state().field.camera.walk, maxDrift: +maxDrift.toFixed(1), path: +L.toFixed(2), bend: +bend.toFixed(3)}; return JSON.stringify(window.__p09); })()

steps.msg: the ease-behind swing goes into the camera, not the walk frame
his path stays straight while the camera swings (no fighting)
the camera really did swing round behind him

steps.note: AUTO-RECENTRE after a pause: stand still and the camera settles behind his facing

steps.msg: the camera recentres behind the hero after a pause

steps.note: THE SCRIPTED WALK through the trees: the hero is never lost behind a canopy
THE CLEAN FADE, A/B: behind a tree with the fade on, then with it off (the old dither)

steps.msg: the tree in front of the hero is registered as an occluder
the camera NEVER zooms in to dodge a tree

steps.note: ... and behind a building: the whole cottage fades, its outline and its shadow stay

steps.msg: the building in front of the hero is registered as an occluder

steps.note: FREE 360 ORBIT: all the way round the hero, the lens never sinking into the ground
Q and E orbit with real keys (Input.look), eased in and out
ZOOM (debug only — never the occluders): in to the hero's face and back out
TALK FRAMING: the view settles lower while somebody is speaking
MODES: interiors are tighter and steeper, dungeons a little tighter, the overworld wider
THE CUTSCENE CAMERA: camera.shot({from, to, lookAt, duration, ease}) for story beats

steps.eval: JSON.stringify(__DQ.cameraShot({from: {orbit: 160, pitch: 6, dist: 11}, to: {orbit: 20, pitch: 34, dist: 6.5}, lookAt: 'hero', duration: 4, ease: 'inOut', hold: true}))

steps.msg: the cutscene camera hands back to the follow camera

steps.note: Puddlewick, once P23 lands it in maps/index.js: a town map gets the town framing automatically

steps.eval: __DQ.listMaps().includes('puddlewick') ? JSON.stringify(__DQ.teleport('puddlewick')) : 'puddlewick is not in maps/index.js yet — staying in the vale'

steps.note: and finally: the camera is settled, nothing errored, and it all ran at speed

steps.msg: >= 50 fps with the fade pass running
the occluder test costs under 3 ms a tick
